events.verdict: Edwards (MIN) releases his off-arm away from Mitchell's (MIA) side and the contact as Edwards spins away from the pick is marginal.
McDaniels (MIN) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Mitchell (MIA) prior to any incidental arm contact occurring.
Adebayo (MIA) establishes a screening position in McDaniels' (MIN) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
McDaniels (MIN) is drawn into the air on the pump fake toward Herro (MIA) and the body contact as Herro elevates is marginal.
Highsmith (MIA) cleanly deflects the ball as Edwards (MIN) makes the pass.
Adebayo (MIA) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Randle (MIN) as simultaneous incidental contact occurs.
Reid (MIN) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Miami.
Randle (MIN) and Adebayo (MIA) mutually engage and disengage with one another during the inbound.
Edwards (MIN) and Herro (MIA) quickly engage and disengage with one another off-ball.
Mitchell (MIA) is established in Randle's (MIN) path and marginal body contact occurs prior to Randle mishandling the ball on his own.

Adebayo (MIA) and Randle (MIN) each make clean contact with the ball as simultaneous incidental arm contact occurs when they go to the floor for the loose ball. Randle then fully establishes possession and requests a timeout while on the ground, which is granted by the officials.
Herro (MIA) cleanly intercepts the pass intended for McDaniels (MIN).
Mitchell (MIA) and McDaniels (MIN) mutually engage and disengage with one another during the inbound.
McDaniels (MIN) makes intentional foot-to-ball contact as the pass is made.
Adebayo (MIA) establishes a screening position in McDaniels' (MIN) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Herro (MIA) shuffles toward Edwards' (MIN) path and the body contact that occurs as the two come together is marginal.
Robinson (MIA) initiates contact across Alexander-Walker's (MIN) front as he makes the pass.
Highsmith (MIA) makes initial marginal contact with McDaniels' (MIN) right arm before cleanly deflecting the ball away during the inbound.
Highsmith's (MIA) forearm touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Minnesota.
Highsmith (MIA) commits a take foul on DiVincenzo (MIN).
Adebayo (MIA) and Randle's (MIN) arms become tangled during the rebound and marginal contact occurs prior to Randle gaining control of the ball.
Adebayo (MIA) commits a take foul on Randle (MIN).
Highsmith (MIA) commits a take foul on Edwards (MIN).
Anderson (MIA) does not inbound the ball within five seconds.
Adebayo (MIA) re-establishes his screening position in DiVincenzo's (MIN) path and the contact that occurs during the screen is marginal.
McDaniels (MIN) is retreating while in Robinson's (MIA) path and the contact that occurs as the two come together is marginal.
McDaniels (MIN) legally contests Robinson's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Highsmith (MIA) cleanly deflects the inbound pass away from Edwards (MIN) as simultaneous marginal body contact occurs.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Possession is awarded to Miami. However, Highsmith (MIA) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds. Possession should have remained with Minnesota.

Randle (MIN) rests his left hand on Adebayo's (MIA) side and marginal contact occurs before Randle makes further incidental "high-five" contact with Adebayo after the release. The ensuing body contact that occurs following the release takes place as a result of Adebayo's lower body drifting forward toward Randle to initiate it.
